extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: A semantic-controlled paired video dataset with over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions for unified semantic-controlled video generation.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was bootstrapped by curating high-quality reference images from the Internet and using commercial image-to-video templates and community LoRAs to generate paired videos by matching each image to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, plus image-to-video visual-effects templates from commercial models VIDU and Kling and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The creators curated thousands of high-quality real images and matched each image to compatible templates to create paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For evaluation, semantic alignment was scored automatically by submitting each reference-generation video pair and evaluation rules to Gemini-2.5-pro; human raters also compared outputs in a user study.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper validates the semantic alignment score by repeating the evaluation with GPT-5 and comparing trends to human preference rates.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper discusses misuse risks including identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and sexualized or violent media, and states the system is research-only and not intended for high-risk deployments.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Because the dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, it may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from the source templates.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; the dataset may inherit source-template artifacts and limitations. Performance also depends on caption quality and subject similarity, and multiple references can cause unwanted blending.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for research on unified semantic-controlled video generation and supports downstream applications such as transferring semantics from reference videos to new subjects, varying semantics for the same image, varying images for the same semantic, and fine-grained prompt-based edits.

name.evidence: We introduce VAP-Data, the largest to date, with over 100 K curated samples across 100 semantic conditions, providing a robust data foundation for unified semantic-controlled video generation.

description.evidence: Overall, we obtain VAP-Data, a semantic-controlled paired dataset with over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions—the largest resource.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: To address this, we collect 2 K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [68] and Kling [40]) and community LoRAs [11] to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates (some restrict subject categories).

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Our solution was to bootstrap it. We curated thousands of high-quality real images and then used the existing “zoo of specialist models” (commercial APIs [40,56,68] and LoRAs [11,27]) as a powerful, automated engine to create our paired dataset, VAP-Data.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We also introduce a semantic-alignment score that measures consistency between the reference and generated videos; we submit each video pair and detailed evaluation rules to Gemini-2.5-pro [12] for automatic scoring. We conducted a user study with 20 randomly selected video-generation researchers to evaluate video quality and semantic alignment.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: To validate the stability of the semantic alignment score, we conduct the same evaluation experiment with another state-of-the-art vision lanuage model GPT-5 [53]; its scores match closely Gemini-2.5-Pro [12] and follow the trends of human preference rate in our user study (see Tab. 5), confirming the validity of the metric.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping, where a reference video and an optional caption steer concept/style/motion/camera. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Despite strong performance, some limitations need further study: (1) We experimented on our large-scale VAP-Data, yet the semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (see Sec. D). Consequently, performance depends on caption quality and on structural similarity between the main subjects: it is stable when caption styles align and subjects are similar, but degrades when descriptions diverge.
